ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels dominating the lobe surfaces against 25% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels concentrated at margins and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs covering the central and distal lobe areas; thick low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge; a vertical low-intensity plume originating at the peduncle insertion and tapering toward the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; pixel-calculated angle is approximately 52 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular amplitude topography; notable high-amplitude valleys (notches) present on the right lobe trailing edge; finer, jagged serrations along the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips; right lobe displays a more irregular terminal sweep due to edge trauma.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of roughly circular high-contrast white nodes on the distal-lateral edge of the right lobe; smaller, isolated white circular clusters visible on the apex of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of two parallel dark linear pixel disruptions in the lower right lobe quadrant and one single vertical linear mark in the lower left lobe quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating acquired physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'spray' or 'fountain' pattern of low-intensity pixels radiating vertically from the fluke base toward the central notch area.
